messages:
jordan: FYI customer saw ~20s of 429s during their hourly ingest job at 01:00 UTC. They reported credits hit 0 instantly. Any ideas? (acct: acct_9f3)

maya: ack, can you paste a snippet of the error headers + approximate timestamps? Also which route? :mag:

jordan: headers from one request:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-credits-remaining: 0
x-rw-credits-reset: 2026-03-07T01:05:02Z
x-rw-rate-limit: 200
```
Timing 01:00:02 - 01:00:22 UTC
route: POST /v1/embeddings (embedder-route)

sam: looks like ephemeral pool got drained. Their ingest runs 60 concurrent workers with short-lived requests — smoothing may not have kicked in because credits were consumed faster than the refill granularity.

alex: smoothing uses `smoothing.window_ms` (default 60000) + a refill tick. If many tiny concurrent spikes, the buffer can be eaten before smoothing evens it out. Also double-check per-route reservations vs global cushion.

jordan: repro plan: 1) run a 60-concurrent load for 30s to /v1/embeddings with the same payload. 2) record `x-rw-credits-remaining` header. I can run from the repro env and attach logs.

maya: please run and paste the logs. Also include the `x-rw-tenant-burst-id` header if present.

jordan: ran: `hey -n 2000 -c 60 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." -D payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` -> saw initial credits 15 -> hit 0 after ~18s -> 429s started. Key log excerpt below:
`[01:00:18Z] INFO request id=rid_abc status=429 credits_remaining=0 tenant=acct_9f3 route=embedder-route`

sam: mitigation suggestions: (1) temporarily increase per-account cushion (burst buffer) (2) enable a per-route smoothing override for embedder-route with a larger window and higher refill (3) advise customer to limit concurrency or add client-side leaky-bucket.

alex: config knobs: `quota.burst_buffer`, `smoothing.window_ms`, `smoothing.refill_rate`, `route.overrides[embedder-route].burst_multiplier`. Quick win: bump `quota.burst_buffer` from 50 -> 200 for this tenant.

maya: action items: jordan will escalate to PROD-OPS to apply a temporary buffer + run a controlled replay. sam to draft long-term tuning doc for ingest patterns. I'll update the customer with ETA. :white_check_mark:

jordan: assigned. I'll post full logs + the `replay.yaml` and ping when done.

ingest-bot: deploy log: applied patch quota.burst_buffer=200 for tenant acct_9f3 at 01:12 UTC

jordan: customer confirmed no 429s on next hourly run. thanks team! :tada:
